propositions: identical inputs (same ticket, same code at HEAD, same acceptance criteria) yield non-deterministic verdicts across runs (PASS vs FAIL-2 vs PASS) within minutes with no intervening changes, making the close gate unreliable in both false-positive (spurious BLOCK) and false-negative (spurious PASS) directions

the verifier's test-existence criterion judgments flip non-deterministically due to variable free-form search strategies (semantic/regex queries fail while literal-substring search succeeds), causing false-FAIL verdicts when test-existence is marked unmet despite the test existing in the tree

the COMPLETION_VERDICT sidecar payload lacks verified_at_sha and trace_id fields, preventing stored data alone from proving input-identity and diagnosing whether verdict flips are caused by input drift or genuine non-determinism
pinning model sampling temperature to 0 (greedy decoding) by default with explicit REBAR_LLM_TEMPERATURE override reduces sampling variance contributing to borderline criterion flips

recording verified_at_sha (immutable commit the verifier ran against) and trace_id (model-run id) in completion sidecar payloads enables future comparisons of identical-input runs to distinguish true non-determinism from input changes

completion verifier documentation must clarify that search_files is literal case-sensitive substring matching (not regex/glob) and that test-existence checks must search by ticket-id and exact symbol before concluding absence
